source: Theorem 4.3 / label th hybrid copy, with the pure-Transformer comparison from Theorems 3.7 and 4.2
exact_imported_claim: Theorem 4.3 constructs a two-layer hybrid (Mamba + attention) model that solves the selective copying task using embedding dimension O(max(log|V|, log L)) and working memory tilde O(N), versus Omega(L) required by pure Transformers.
domain: All length-L vocabulary sequences containing at least one number token; the source target is undefined when its argmax set is empty.
assumptions: Number tokens encode distances 1 through N and N <= L.
The most recent number token is the control distance.
The output is the token at relative distance equal to that control.
Token and relative-position codes are distinct +/-1 binary encodings.
pass_condition: A two-layer construction, symbolic resource/correctness certificate, exhaustive complete-domain checks, independent checker, and failing control establish the exact target for every defined input.
falsification_condition: A valid input satisfying all source assumptions causes the certified construction or existential resource bounds to fail.
